references.label: captive ball
references.description: Hit the captive ball twice in succession, with the second hit inside the displayed window, to damage the enemy.

references.label: center bank
references.description: Hit the center bank to lower the red dragon.

references.label: center-spinner
references.description: Complete the orange targets or make center-spinner hits until Dungeon Crawl is qualified.

references.label: Hidden Temple
references.description: Lane behind the upper flipper. Shoot it while lit to start 20 seconds of 2x playfield scoring.

references.label: Hidden Temple lane
references.description: Hit the Secret Door bar target, then shoot the lit Hidden Temple lane behind the upper flipper to start 20 seconds of 2x playfield scoring.

references.label: left orbit
references.description: Shoot the left orbit to lower the left ramp, then shoot the lowered ramp.

references.label: left ramp
references.description: Shoot the left orbit to lower the left ramp, then shoot the lowered ramp.

references.label: right orbit
references.description: In Arabel, complete D-R-A-G-O-N and start Retrieve a Potion from a yellow Choose Action shot, then shoot the right orbit to add Dragon Multiball.

references.label: Secret Door
references.description: Bar target in front of Hidden Temple. Hit it to light the Hidden Temple lane.

references.label: side ramp
references.description: The side ramp is an alternate Dragon Multiball start only when no other mode is running.

references.label: upper loop
references.description: Collecting all four jackpots lights the upper loop for a 20,000,000 Super Jackpot and resets the jackpot sequence.
